code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    """Fill the interiors of rectangular outline objects with color 7."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row if v != bg}
    for color in colors:
        pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in pts), max(r for r, c in pts)
        c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in pts), max(c for r, c in pts)
        # Only fill true rectangular frames: all four sides are the object's color.
        if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
            continue
        if not (all(grid[r0][c] == color for c in range(c0, c1+1)) and
                all(grid[r1][c] == color for c in range(c0, c1+1)) and
                all(grid[r][c0] == color for r in range(r0, r1+1)) and
                all(grid[r][c1] == color for r in range(r0, r1+1))):
            continue
        for r in range(r0+1, r1):
            for c in range(c0+1, c1):
                if grid[r][c] == bg:
                    out[r][c] = 7
    return out
'''

code='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    """Fill each hollow square frame; odd sides use 7, even sides use 2."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()
    for sr in range(h):
        for sc in range(w):
            color = grid[sr][sc]
            if color == bg or (sr, sc) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(sr, sc)]); seen.add((sr, sc)); pts=[]
            while q:
                r,c=q.popleft(); pts.append((r,c))
                for nr,nc in ((r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)):
                    if 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w and (nr,nc) not in seen and grid[nr][nc]==color:
                        seen.add((nr,nc)); q.append((nr,nc))
            r0,r1=min(r for r,c in pts),max(r for r,c in pts)
            c0,c1=min(c for r,c in pts),max(c for r,c in pts)
            if r1-r0<2 or c1-c0<2:
                continue
            if not (all(grid[r0][c]==color for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and
                    all(grid[r1][c]==color for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and
                    all(grid[r][c0]==color for r in range(r0,r1+1)) and
                    all(grid[r][c1]==color for r in range(r0,r1+1))):
                continue
            fill=7 if (r1-r0+1)%2 else 2
            for r in range(r0+1,r1):
                for c in range(c0+1,c1):
                    if grid[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=fill
    return out
